style_verdict.runes: standard historical Anglo-Saxon Futhorc, mapped to custom Gematria Primus (29 runes to 29 primes). NOT a designed typeface. The 'Primus' TTF font (Saad Jamadar) is a POST-HOC fan recreation, not the source.
style_verdict.cicada_emblem: processed PHOTO/collage, not a hand illustration: real dead cicada scanned + Photoshop emboss filter; also a composite ('collage', L/R hindwing veins differ) tracing the public-domain engraving of Distantalna splendida from W.L. Distant, A Monograph of Oriental Cicadidae (1889-1892).
style_verdict.corpse_trees: filter-processed / hand-drawn line + graphite elements; serve CRYPTOGRAPHIC roles (rotation/mirroring/set-navigation) per community, not artist signatures.
style_verdict.crosses: high-contrast rough-brush black-ink woodcut-emulation, standard 3-bar Christian cross form (public-domain iconography).

attribution: NO attributable individual hand. EXIF fully stripped (Round 29). Art is a mix of (a) public-domain historical/scientific source imagery digitally processed, and (b) generic line/graphite drawings functioning as cipher-navigation cues.
